correctness.rationale: The known affine kernel gives norm=1+2C_n with a negative polygon-cap mass C_n. Rational error-bounded shoelace cap evaluation certifies C_n>1/2 for n=3..6 and C_n<1/2 for n=7..11. For n>=11, disk inclusion and monotonicity of A_n and k_n imply C_n<=pi B(k_11)/A_11<1/2, with strict rational upper enclosure. Independent direct shoelace values for n=3..199 corroborated (not proved) the signs; the infinite tail is analytical. The repair drops originality claims for the previously published general norm, vertex norming, and 5*pi*sqrt15/12 disk coefficient.

broader_coverage.reasoning: All-n formula, vertex normers, and 5*pi*sqrt(15)/12 are already in three earlier papers, so original unrestricted novelty fails. Their printed theorems do not give a strict all-n six/seven phase separation; new independent majorant and rational interval proof are needed for the surviving focused claim.
